## Refundable Portion - Subsection (d)(1)

The refundable portion allows taxpayers to receive credit amounts that exceed their tax liability:

The refundable portion is capped, with inflation adjustments applied: "The amount determined under subsection (d)(1)(A) with respect to any qualifying child shall not exceed $1,400, and such subsection shall be applied without regard to paragraph (4) of this subsection."
